create_Input: create an Input dataclass instance with tokenized text and optional images for Gemma model inference
create_InputConfig: create an InputConfig dataclass with image support settings and special tokens for the Gemma model
build_attention_mask: build a causal bidirectional attention mask from an Input instance including multimodal tokens
build_tokens_with_mm: build tokens with multimodal placeholders inserted for images using the Input tokens_with_mm property
pad_Input: pad an Input instance to a target length preserving multimodal token spacing using the pad method
